en.shortDescription: Open source message broker and queue
en.longDescription:
RabbitMQ is a widely used message broker supporting AMQP, MQTT, and STOMP for reliable async messaging.

Management UI on SERVICE_PORT_RABBITMQ_15672 (15672). Credentials use SERVICE_USER_RABBITMQ and SERVICE_PASSWORD_RABBITMQ.

de.longDescription:
RabbitMQ ist ein weit verbreiteter Message-Broker, der AMQP, MQTT und STOMP für zuverlässiges asynchrones Messaging unterstützt.

Management-UI unter SERVICE_PORT_RABBITMQ_15672 (15672). Zugangsdaten verwenden SERVICE_USER_RABBITMQ und SERVICE_PASSWORD_RABBITMQ.

fr.shortDescription: Courtier de messages et file d'attente open source
fr.longDescription:
RabbitMQ est un courtier de messages largement utilisé prenant en charge AMQP, MQTT et STOMP pour une messagerie asynchrone fiable.

UI de gestion sur SERVICE_PORT_RABBITMQ_15672 (15672). Les identifiants utilisent SERVICE_USER_RABBITMQ et SERVICE_PASSWORD_RABBITMQ.

pt.shortDescription: Corretor de mensagens e fila open-source
pt.longDescription:
RabbitMQ é um message broker amplamente usado, com suporte a AMQP, MQTT e STOMP para mensageria assíncrona confiável.

UI de gerenciamento em SERVICE_PORT_RABBITMQ_15672 (15672). As credenciais usam SERVICE_USER_RABBITMQ e SERVICE_PASSWORD_RABBITMQ.
